Sam and the Monkey

Dark Phonics · Week 7 (m) · hybrid reader · Gate: Lesson 11 · potato finale
Page 1

’A monkey sat on the…’ mat!

The muddy Monkey arrives, banana and all.
Page 2

’Sam sat on the…’ mat!

Sam the peg-doll boy joins the cast — his name needs /m/.
Page 3

’The cat sat on the…’ mat!

The tabby squeezes on. The mat is getting crowded.
Page 4

’The monkey sat on…’ Sam!

The gag — the monkey sits right on Sam.
Page 5

’And the…?!’

(wordless — the class shouts it)

The monkey sits it on the mat between Sam and the cat. The word is never printed.
